Definition: a prolonged form of an obsolete primary θίγω (to finger); to manipulate, i.e. have to do with; by implication, to injure:--handle, touch.
BiblicalUsage: The word thingánō is the Bible's way of saying handle, touch. In Colossians 2:21, (Touch not, taste not, and it appears again in Hebrews 11:28.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe handle, touch still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
